Each case study explains the question, the data, the methods, the findings and the limitations. Use the search box to filter by title or category.

## How I approach a project

<div class="steps">
<div class="step"><b>1. Question</b><p>Start with a clearly defined question and the decision it supports.</p></div>
<div class="step"><b>2. Data</b><p>Examine the quality, structure and gaps in the data.</p></div>
<div class="step"><b>3. Methods</b><p>Choose methods that fit the question and document every step.</p></div>
<div class="step"><b>4. Communicate</b><p>Present findings together with their limitations.</p></div>
</div>
